experiment: U9 Galilean boost + Mercury anchor (repaired v2)

frame_test_reading.gr_1pn: fails in-plane, but BY CONSTRUCTION: absolute v_i (single-body Sun-frame formula); the sign-fixed law has the same y/rest ratio (DOP853: 5.885346 vs 5.885335), so this is not evidence of a defect beyond the undocumented frame dependence
frame_test_reading.eih_cross: fails for the y-boost (x2.1930) and drifts e under the x-boost; restoring only the cross-term sign gives +6 u in all four frames (DOP853), so the frame dependence is the same defect as the sign

test_fixture_eih_vs_1pn.note: n.v = 0 at this state; the cross term vanishes, the radial 1PN terms of the two layers have opposite signs

prereg_notes.rest_frame_predictions: gr_1pn -6 u and eih_cross -10 u were written in the u9_orbits.py docstring (03:01) before any orbit ran: genuine advance predictions, confirmed.
prereg_notes.boosted_frame_gauss_predictions: u9_gauss.py was last edited at 03:05 but its integrals were evaluated at 03:20, after orbits_p1-p3 (03:07-03:11, containing the rest/x/y/z runs) were written. The boosted-frame values (6.384, 35.31, -21.93 u, de -6.054 and -2.453 u) are therefore a post-hoc explanation, not advance predictions. The orbit-script criteria (anchor 1 %, frame 1 %, controls) were fixed before the runs and did not move.
prereg_notes.sph_prediction_c_missed: u9_instant.py prediction (c) forecast SPH roundoff ~1e-12..1e-11 at V = 1 km/s and said the design's 1e-12 line 'may be crossed by roundoff alone'. Measured 1.15e-13..1.96e-13: 5-50x smaller, the line was not crossed at 1 km/s. The magnitude prediction missed; the scaling prediction (proportional to V, 0 without viscosity) held.
prereg_notes.repair_criteria_D1_D4: fixed in the u9_dop853_v2.py docstring before that script ran (all met).
